title: WALK TO BROADWAY-DOWNTOWN-KING BED-GYM-PARKING
description:
This cozy 3rd floor space is steps from Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, Ryman Auditorium, The Country Music Hall of Fame, Nissan Stadium, Ascend Amphitheater, Riverfront Park, Nashville Symphony and many more top Nashville destinations.

Plus, you’ll love access to the resort-style amenities including:
• outdoor pool (plenty of chairs!)
• outdoor patio with grills & fire pits
• large fitness center with climbing wall and yoga room
• chic Sky lounge and patio

The space
This unit features an ultra plush, king sized, completely separate bedroom with a 50" Smart TV. The spacious living room features 2 daybed couches, a 55" Smart TV, and multiple closets. Also includes a full sized and fully equipped kitchen and 1 full bath with a garden tub and shower! Your balcony, overlooks the beautiful courtyard full of amenities.

This home away from home will provide you with everything you need to make your stay easy and enjoyable. The space offers 10’ ceilings, hardwood floors, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, in-unit washer/dryer, coffee maker and supplies, Wifi, Bluetooth speaker system, kitchen/bathroom essentials, and trash pickup.

The unit also comes with one free parking spot in the covered & secure parking garage underneath the building.

The unit is professionally cleaned between all stays.

If you have questions on anything before, during or after your stay..I am very accessible - simply call, text or email.

Guest access
Along with your stay, you will receive full access to building amenities including; community coffeehouse, state of the art fitness center with climbing wall/yoga room, Sky lounge, pool, fire pits, gas BBQ grills, and courtyard patio.

With access to the amenity deck, you can conveniently take a dip in the resort style pool, lounge in the courtyard & gazebo, or play yard games! Get a sweat in at the two story fitness facility featuring a rock wall or get some work done in our quiet Collective workspace downstairs!

Other things to note
This rental has the appropriate Short Term Rental Permit from the City of Nashville (permit #2018070974).

*Amenity closures due to repairs or other issues are out of the host's control and no reimbursement will be given in this event.
